notes.title: Weekly improvements and patches update!!
notes.notes:
As usual continuing my commitment to my players and ensuring this game is as best as it can be. Once again another playthrough this week and loads of different bugs fixed and improvements.

- El Kitaro stated that going alone but party comes. Party clearer created
- Fire demon and other fire creatures powers given
- Azumi needs a boat script error fixed
- Gunhild sleep loop fixed
- Percy now appears
- Perry has better tiger slash graphic
- flushing at food harbour now works
- Stop laundry sound once out of laundry
- Removed old escape to Astrotarium
- Rescue Stirry quest reappearing in quest list fixed
- False game completion achievement fixed
- Overlap of text for chef in cat castle fixed
- Loyla enthusiast in school image fixed
- Wendy sweets had a bug if you eat them now fixed
- Kenix home DV version credits removed
- Conditional to find El Kitaro gone happens if you just get into car park

notes.title: Minor improvements update
notes.notes:
I would not blame you if you feel like "this guy has no life" because yet again I have updated this game with many improvements. They are listed below but I warn you this may constitute a spoiler. 



- Typo corrected at Queen Dystorpia chat with book

- Dark Fire, Dystorpia powers now are not more than 50 to cast

- Puzzle master skill etc.. removed as of no use

- Battle in temple now is a group one not one by one as tedious

- Better rewards from Senor El Fuego

- Better Azumi witch increases after mission

- Cat King gets more from divine catnip



As promised each week I will keep improving this game and keeping you happy. 



Thank you all for your patronage!!



Kenix and Merrifield Publishers Ltd

notes.notes:

Thanks for your support!
